page.home.title.en: Chun Kai Xin · Chinese Language Teacher & EdTech Builder
page.home.title.zh: 郑凯欣 · 华文教师 · 教育科技开发者

work.intro.en: Tools, structures and processes built for specific classroom problems, all of them in use.
work.intro.zh: 为具体的课堂问题而做的工具、机制和流程，目前都在使用中。

approach.leadA.en: Design thinking is usually drawn as a tidy five step loop: empathise, define, ideate, prototype, test. In a classroom, only the test settles anything. A tool is not good because the thinking behind it was good. It is good because thirty students opened it on a Monday morning and it held.
approach.leadA.zh: 设计思维常被画成一个工整的五步循环：同理、定义、构思、原型、测试。但在课堂里，真正说了算的只有「测试」。工具好不好，不看背后的想法有多好，而看三十个学生星期一早上打开它，它撑不撑得住。

approach.leadB.en: So I run the loop, but I run it short and I run it often. The gap comes from evidence: a real script, a real mark, what students say when I ask them. The prototype is a working build, not a mockup. The test is a real lesson with students who will not humour anything that wastes their time. And the next version starts that same week, because by then the classroom has already told me what to fix.
approach.leadB.zh: 这个循环我照跑，只是跑得短、跑得勤。缺口来自证据：一份考卷、一个分数、问学生时他们怎么说。原型是能跑的版本，不是示意图。测试是一堂真实的课，学生觉得浪费时间就不会买账。下一版通常同一周就动工，因为课堂那时已经告诉我要改什么。

approach.loop1Title.en: The gap has to be one I actually saw

approach.loop1Body.en: A gap I can point at is a design brief. A gap I assumed is a guess wearing a lanyard. One student's comprehension paper is what showed me a problem across the whole cohort, and the cohort is what the tool then had to answer to.
approach.loop1Body.zh: 指得出来的缺口，才是设计任务；靠揣测来的，不过是挂着工作证的猜想。一个学生的理解问答考卷，让我看见整个级别的问题；工具后来要应付的，也就是整个级别。

approach.loop2Title.en: Build the thing, not a picture of it
approach.loop2Title.zh: 做出东西来，而不是画一张示意图

approach.loop2Body.en: A mockup can test an idea. A working build tells me what happens in class. A student will tell you in forty seconds what a proposal deck could not tell you in a term, so I skip the polished pitch and ship something small that runs.
approach.loop2Body.zh: 示意图能试想法，能跑的版本才告诉我课堂上会发生什么。学生四十秒里说的，一份提案简报一个学期也说不出来。所以我跳过打磨提案，先做一个小而能跑的东西。

approach.loop3Title.en: Putting it into practice: the classroom is the test, not the demo
approach.loop3Title.zh: 实践：课堂才是测试，演示不是

approach.loop3Body.en: Colleagues nodding at a demo is not evidence. Students using it independently, in an ordinary lesson, without step-by-step prompting from me, is evidence. Everything I have built went in front of students within days of being usable, and most of what I now think about the design I learnt there.
approach.loop3Body.zh: 同事在演示时点头，不算证据。学生在一堂普通的课上自己用，不用我一句一句提示，才算。我做的东西，勉强能用就送到学生面前；今天对设计的判断，多半是在那里学到的，不是事先想好的。

approach.loop4Title.en: Let the evidence write the next version
approach.loop4Title.zh: 让证据来写下一个版本

approach.loop4Body.en: Which words keep failing. Which screen nobody visits. Which instruction I have to repeat out loud every single time. Those are the design documents. Opinions, including my own, get outranked by them.
approach.loop4Body.zh: 哪些词一错再错。哪个页面没人去。哪一句指示我每次都得再讲一遍。这些才是设计文档。任何意见，包括我自己的，都排在它们后面。

approach.loop5Title.en: The loop does not resolve, it climbs
approach.loop5Title.zh: 循环不会收束，它只会向上

approach.loop5Body.en: Practise, understand, practise again. No version is final and none of them was meant to be. Each turn of the loop begins from a better question than the last one, which is the only kind of progress I trust.
approach.loop5Body.zh: 实践、认识、再实践。没有哪一版是最终版，本来也不打算是。每一圈都从一个比上一圈更好的问题开始，这是我唯一信得过的进展。
